capabilities.value: Coordinates session startup, safety, context injection, maintenance and closeout around the user's work.

capability_families.outcome: Meeting material can become context, decisions and reviewable follow-up while the original source stays within the approved local boundary.
capability_families.title: Meetings become visible next steps

capability_families.outcome: People, companies, relationships and open threads can be refreshed over time so important conversations start with current context.
capability_families.title: People and company context stays alive

capability_families.outcome: Promises and tasks can be captured, linked, scheduled and completed without losing their owner, source or place in the wider work.
capability_families.title: Tasks keep their thread

capability_families.outcome: Todoist, Things and Trello can exchange task updates on request, with explicit review rather than a claim of invisible background polling.
capability_families.title: External task tools stay reviewable

capability_families.outcome: Calendar, mail, meetings and collaboration services can inform local work when explicitly connected. A directory of hundreds of connector definitions makes more tools discoverable, but only connectors Dex has explicitly supported and security-vetted are treated as ready to use; held connection routes remain groundwork.
capability_families.title: Connected work context is understandable

capability_families.outcome: Pipedrive deal and organisation facts can inform local planning, while external writes stay previewed and confirmation-gated.
capability_families.title: Pipeline context reaches local work

capability_families.outcome: Daily planning, weekly priorities, review and reflection form one repeatable cadence instead of a set of disconnected prompts.
capability_families.title: Daily and weekly rhythm compounds

capability_families.outcome: Decisions, observations, useful context and patterns remain searchable and sourced across sessions without pretending stale memory is current truth.
capability_families.title: Work memory survives the session

capability_families.outcome: Health checks distinguish working, off, broken and unknown paths, then point to bounded recovery evidence instead of treating a started process as proof.
capability_families.title: Dex can explain its own health

capability_families.outcome: A person can create a recovery copy and rehearse restoring it with fingerprints and boundaries checked before trusting it.
capability_families.title: Backups can be restored with confidence

capability_families.outcome: Supported updates and local configuration changes pass through preview, backup, verification and receipt-backed rewind rather than editing the live system blindly.
capability_families.title: Changes stay reviewable and rewindable

capability_families.outcome: A person can inspect, create, review and adopt methods through explicit lifecycle boundaries without copying somebody else's private system. Customization migration is surfaced here only for assessment and capsule evidence; activation and rewind remain held.
capability_families.title: Useful capability is discoverable and adoptable

assessment.reason: A person must decide what can be shared; a detector cannot infer consent from source text.

capability_families.outcome: A problem or improvement can be reduced to a minimal, reviewable signal and returned as a bounded answer without turning private vault content into a report.
capability_families.title: Feedback can improve Dex without exporting private work

capability_families.outcome: Career and resume workflows turn consented evidence into truthful development and application support without inventing claims.
capability_families.title: Career growth stays evidence-based
